comment: Tobin: a new NPC (a clone of the fisher trader), one per world, in the game's roster, with a short voiced quest in the game's journal. docs/kiln/services/npcs.md.

tobin_met.comment: his unlock: without it the game destroys him (a roster NPC whose unlock does not hold)

description.en: Tobin the Wanderer trades a little and keeps a fire going for anyone who brings him kindling.
description.de: Tobin der Wanderer handelt ein wenig und hält ein Feuer am Brennen für alle, die ihm Anzünder bringen.

summonItem.name: Kiln_NpcSample_TobinTool
summonItem.comment: named after him, as every tool of the game: the Survivors list shows this item's name and description, so they come from the NPC above

en.caption: Tobin's Whistle
en.primaryAction: Call Tobin here, or send him to a bed

de.caption: Tobins Pfeife
de.primaryAction: Tobin hierher rufen oder zu einem Bett schicken

vendor.comment: a clone shares its base's workshop: this trade also shows at the fisher trader

balthazar.comment: a game NPC: one more topic in his menu, the game's own lines stay

reply.en: The wanderer? He trades with anyone who has twigs to spare.
reply.de: Den Wanderer? Er handelt mit jedem, der Zweige übrig hat.

text.en: Well met, Flameborn. The night is cold and my fire is dying.
text.de: Sei gegrüßt, Flammengeborener. Die Nacht ist kalt und mein Feuer geht aus.

text.en: I can find you some kindling.

reply.en: Three twigs would do. Bless you.
Bless you. Take this whistle, and call on me whenever you like.
reply.de: Sei gesegnet. Nimm diese Pfeife und ruf mich, wann immer du willst.

reply.en: Just a wanderer. I trade a little, if you have twigs to spare.
reply.de: Nur ein Wanderer. Ich handle ein wenig, wenn du Zweige übrig hast.
